_doc: User-controlled defender (play/interception.ts, PlaySim). jump: the JUMP button lunges toward the ball (in the air) or the receiver; the jump peaks peakAt s after the press. window: |peak - ball arrival| in seconds for each timing grade. effects: added to the defender's breakup / interception chance and reach (yd) in resolveCatch. A mistimed jump (early/late) is worse than no jump. A pick needs perfect timing AND position: it is an event, not routine.
